# Advanced acoustic workshop

[Framhaldsnámskeið í hljóðmælingum]{.is}

Marine and Freshwater Research Institute, Hafnarfjörður
:::

Four days on calibration, ADCP operation, acoustic scrutiny with Korona and LSSS, biomass estimation in R, AI for data processing, and MFRI acoustic data in the cloud — closing with project work and a field trip to Teledyne Gavia.
